strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software yevatengesi nekutengesa nevheni
strings.tierB.home.description: Software yevagoveri: invoisi nerisiti pafoni yemutengesi, sitoko yevheni, mari inounganidzwa, nzira nekushanya. Inoshanda pasina indaneti.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Tungamira vatengesi vako kubva pakushanya kwekutanga kusvika pamuripo wekupedzisira
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ipuratifomu ye-cloud yemakambani anogovera nekutengesa zvakawanda ane vatengesi vanoshanyira vatengi. Vatengesi vanobudisa nekudhinda invoisi nerisiti pafoni yavo, vanotevera sitoko yevheni uye vanonyora kushanya kwavo, apo mamaneja anoona kutengesa, mari yaunganidzwa nemabharanzi evatengi ipapo ipapo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoisi pafoni yemutengesi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Mutengesi anobudisa invoisi pamusuwo wemutengi obva aidhinda paprinta ye-thermal ine Bluetooth asati abuda muchitoro.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Mari inounganidzwa nemabharanzi evatengi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Muripo wega wega unowana risiti ine nhamba yakabatanidzwa neinvoisi dzaunobhadhara, uye bharanzi nesitatimendi zvemutengi zvinogadziriswa ipapo ipapo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Sitoko yevheni yakachengetwa nemutengesi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Sitoko yevheni imwe neimwe inoteverwa chinhu nechinhu: zvakarodhwa, zvakatengeswa, zvakadzoserwa nezvasara, saka kusiyana kunooneka zuva iroro.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Nzira nekushanya
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Kushanya kunonyorwa nenzvimbo, nguva nemifananidzo, uye nzira yemutengesi mumwe nemumwe inoratidzwa pamepu kuti maneja aione.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Inoshanda pasina indaneti
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Vatengesi vanoramba vachitengesa kunyange pasina netiweki. Magwaro anomirira pafoni obva atumirwa ega, asingadzokororwi, netiweki yadzoka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashboard yewebhu yemamaneja
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Kutengesa, mari yaunganidzwa, zvinhu zvadzoserwa, sitoko nekushanda kwevatengesi panzvimbo imwe, pamwe nezvinzvimbo nekodzero zvemushandisi wega wega.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tiudze matengesero aunoita
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Kumbira kotesheni kana kuti bhuka musangano. Tinotarisa vatengesi vako, nzira, zvigadzirwa nezvaunoda painvoisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Gadzirisa kambani yako
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Isa zvigadzirwa, mitengo, vatengi nevatengesi, wobva waisa mari nechiyero chemutero chenyika yako pamarongero.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tumira vatengesi munzira
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Vatengesi vanoisa app paAndroid kana iPhone, vanorodha vheni yavo vobva vatanga kutengesa, kudhinda nekuunganidza mari.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Tevera zuva sezvarinoitika
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashboard yewebhu inoratidza kutengesa, mari yaunganidzwa, sitoko yemavheni nekushanya vatengesi vachiri munzira.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ipuratifomu ye-cloud yekutungamira vatengesi vanoshanyira vatengi mumakambani anogovera nekutengesa zvakawanda. Inosanganisira kutengesa nevheni (van sales), kutengesa munzira dzakarongwa (route sales), kutora maodha pachine nguva (pre-sales) nekuendesa zvinhu zvakananga kuzvitoro (DSD). Vatengesi vanobudisa invoisi, vanodhinda, vanounganidza mari uye vanonyora kushanya pafoni yavo, apo mamaneja anotevera kutengesa, mari yaunganidzwa, sitoko yemavheni nemabharanzi evatengi padashboard yewebhu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Hongu. App yemutengesi inoramba ichishanda pasina indaneti: vatengesi vanobudisa nekudhinda invoisi nerisiti, vanonyora kushanya uye vanowedzera vatengi vatsva, uye zvese zvinotumirwa zvega zvisingadzokororwi netiweki yadzoka. Pane musiyano mumwe chete kuSaudi Arabia: makambani akavhura kubatanidzwa kweinvoisi dzedhijitari anoda netiweki panguva yekubudisa invoisi kana gwaro rezvinhu zvadzoserwa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales inoshandira makambani anogovera munyika dzese. Kambani imwe neimwe inoisa mari yayo nechiyero chemutero pamarongero ayo, uye invoisi, risiti nemishumo zvinozvishandisa. FieldSales ine muzinda wayo muRiyadh, kuSaudi Arabia, uye kutanga kunoitwa paindaneti kuburikidza nemisangano, WhatsApp nerubatsiro rwuri kure.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales inobatana here nemasisitimu ehurumende einvoisi dzedhijitari?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Tinotsigira kubatanidzwa kweChikamu Chechipiri nepuratifomu yeFatoora yeZATCA. Izvi zvinoshanda kumakambani ari muSaudi Arabia. Mune dzimwe nyika, FieldSales inobudisa invoisi nemari yako nechiyero chako chemutero, uye kubatanidzwa nesisitimu yenyika yeinvoisi dzedhijitari (e-invoicing) kunowanikwa kana kwakumbirwa, mushure mekunge taongorora zvinodiwa nenyika iyoyo tiri tese. Kunze kweSaudi Arabia hatiiti vimbiso pamusoro pemitemo yemunyika imomo.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: App yeFieldSales inowanikwa mumitauro iyi chete: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese. Haiwanikwe muchiShona. Vatengesi nemamaneja vanogona kuchinja mutauro weapp, uye invoisi dzakadhindwa dzinogona kuva nemutauro wechipiri padivi pemutauro mukuru. Mapeji ewebhusaiti mune mimwe mitauro, sepeji rino reChiShona, ishanduro dzinopa ruzivo nezvechigadzirwa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Kumbira kotesheni, bhuka musangano kana kuti titumire meseji paWhatsApp. Tinodzidza mashandiro anoita vatengesi vako, tobva takubatsira kuisa zvigadzirwa, mitengo, vatengi nevatengesi. Vatengesi vanoisa app paAndroid kana iPhone, uye mamaneja anoshandisa dashboard yewebhu pabrowser ipi neipi. Midziyo chete yaunoda ma-smartphone.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: App yeFieldSales inowanikwa mumitauro iyi: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; haiwanikwe muchiShona. Mapeji mune mimwe mitauro anotsanangura chigadzirwa kuti uwane ruzivo chete.
strings.tierB.category.title: Software yekutengesa nevheni (van sales) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Software yekutengesa nevheni (van sales): invoisi dzinodhindwa nefoni, sitoko yevheni, mari inounganidzwa nekushanya. Inoshanda pasina indaneti.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Software yekutengesa nevheni yevagoveri nevatengesi vezvakawanda
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales i-software yekutengesa nevheni yemakambani ane vatengesi vanotengesa vari muvheni munzira dzemazuva ese. Mutengesi anorodha vheni, otengesa pachitoro chimwe nechimwe, odhinda invoisi, ounganidza mari uye onyora zvinhu zvadzoserwa, zvese neapp imwe chete yefoni. Maneja anoona zvakarodhwa, zvakatengeswa, mari yakaunganidzwa nezvasara muvheni imwe neimwe.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Software yekutengesa nevheni chii?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Software yekutengesa nevheni, inonziwo software ye-route sales, inofambisa nzira yekutengesa umo mutengesi anotakura sitoko mumotokari otengesa, oendesa zvinhu, obudisa invoisi uye ounganidza mari pakushanya kumwe chete. Inotsiva mabhuku einvoisi emapepa nekufonerana kwekupera kwezuva. Inonyora kutengesa kwese, muripo uye zvinhu zvadzoserwa segwaro, saka sitoko nemari zvinogona kuenzaniswa zuva iroro. Kuna maneja, inopindura mibvunzo mitatu manheru ega ega: mutengesi mumwe nemumwe atengesei, aunganidza marii, uye chii chasara muvheni imwe neimwe?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Zuva munzira
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Zuva rinotanga nekurodha kwakanyorwa kubva mudura kuenda muvheni. Pachitoro chimwe nechimwe mutengesi anosarudza mutengi muapp, owedzera zvinhu kubva parondedzero kana nebarcode, obudisa invoisi oidhinda paprinta ye-thermal. Muripo unonyorwa nerisiti, uye chero chinhu chadzoserwa chinonyorwa pamwe nechikonzero chacho. Pakupera kwezuva, zvasara muvheni zvinodzoserwa mudura. Pakati pematanho aya, maneja anogona kutevera kutengesa, mari yaunganidzwa nekushanya kwemutengesi mumwe nemumwe padashboard yewebhu asina waanofonera.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yakagadzirirwa nzvimbo dzine netiweki shoma
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Nzira dzekugovera dzinopfuura mumabhesimendi, munzvimbo dzemaindasitiri nemumaruwa umo netiweki isina simba. App yemutengesi yeFieldSales inochengeta vatengi, zvigadzirwa nemitengo pafoni, saka mutengesi anogona kubudisa nekudhinda magwaro pasina indaneti. Gwaro rimwe nerimwe rine kiyi yaro yakasiyana, saka rinosvika kamwe chete, kunyange kutumira kukadzokororwa. Makambani ari muSaudi Arabia akavhura kubatanidzwa kweinvoisi dzedhijitari anoda netiweki panguva yekubudisa invoisi nemagwaro ezvinhu zvadzoserwa. Risiti, kushanya nevatengi vatsva zvinoramba zvichishanda pasina indaneti mumakambani iwayo.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Mari inounganidzwa nesitoko yevheni
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Mari iri munzira inoda kutarisirwa sezvinoitwa sitoko. Muripo wega wega unowana risiti ine nhamba inogona kubatanidzwa neinvoisi dzaunobhadhara, uye bharanzi yemutengi inogadziriswa ipapo ipapo. Sitoko yevheni inoverengwa chinhu nechinhu sezvakarodhwa kubvisa zvakatengeswa, kuwedzera zvadzoserwa nezvigadziriso zvakanyorwa, saka mamaneja anogona kuienzanisa nekuverenga kwechokwadi mutengesi asati aenda kumba. Zvinhu zvadzoserwa zvinogona kurongwa sezvakajairika, zvakakuvara kana zvekuchinjana, uye maneja ndiye anosarudza kana zvichidzokera musitoko yevheni yakagadzirira kutengeswa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Yakakodzera vanaani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales yakakodzera vagoveri nevatengesi vezvakawanda vezvinhu zvinotengeswa nekukurumidza (FMCG) zvakaita sezvokudya, zvinwiwa, zvekuchenesa nezvekuzvitarisira, uye chero kambani ine vatengesi vanoshanyira zvitoro, ma-tuck-shop nezvitoro zvidiki munzira dzakarongwa. Inotsigira kutengesa nevheni, maodha epachine nguva (pre-sales) nekuendesa zvinhu zvakananga kuzvitoro (DSD). Haisi ERP yakazara: inobatana nesisitimu yako ye-accounting kana ERP kuburikidza neAPI. Mamaneja anotonga zvinogona kuitwa nemutengesi mumwe nemumwe, sekupa dhisikaundi, kutengesa pasi pemutengo uri parondedzero kana kuwedzera vatengi vatsva.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Musiyano upi pakati pekutengesa nevheni ne-pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Pakutengesa nevheni mutengesi anotakura sitoko oendesa zvinhu, obudisa invoisi uye ounganidza mari pakushanya kumwe chete. Mu-pre-sales mutengesi anotora odha inozoendeswa nedura gare gare. FieldSales inotsigira nzira mbiri idzi, saka kambani inogona kushandisa mavheni pane dzimwe nzira yotora maodha pane dzimwe. Munzira mbiri idzi, invoisi, mari yaunganidzwa nemabharanzi evatengi zviri musisitimu imwe chete, uye mamaneja anozviona mumishumo imwe chete.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ndinoenzanisa sei sitoko yevheni pakupera kwezuva?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales inoratidza, pachinhu chimwe nechimwe muvheni imwe neimwe, huwandu hwakarodhwa, hwakatengeswa, hwakadzoserwa nehwasara. Enzanisa zvasara nekuverenga kwechokwadi, nyora kusiyana kupi nekupi sechigadziriso chakanyorwa, wobva wadzosera zvasara mudura nekufamba kumwe chete. Vheni inotanga zuva rinotevera iine bharanzi yakachena inozivikanwa.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Mutengesi anotengesa nevheni anoda midziyo ipi?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android kana iPhone. Printa ye-thermal ine Bluetooth haimanikidzwe, uye inobatsira mutengesi kupa mutengi invoisi kana risiti yakadhindwa. FieldSales haitengesi midziyo uye haidi rudzi rwakati rweprinta. Mamaneja anoshandisa dashboard yewebhu pabrowser yekombiyuta kana foni ipi neipi.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales inogona kubatana nesisitimu yedu ye-accounting here?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Hongu. FieldSales inopa API inobatsira sisitimu yako ye-accounting kana ERP kuchinjana vatengi, zvigadzirwa, invoisi, risiti nekufamba kwesitoko nepuratifomu. Chikwata chako kana kambani yako ye-IT inovaka kubatana uku ichishandisa magwaro eAPI.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales munyika: mari, mutero ne-e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales inoshandira vagoveri munyika dzese. Ona mari, mutero wekutengesa nemamiriro e-invoicing munyika imwe neimwe patafura imwe.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales inoshandira makambani anogovera munyika dzese. Kambani imwe neimwe inosarudza nyika yayo, mari nechiyero chemutero pamarongero ayo, uye invoisi, risiti nemishumo zvinozvitevera. Kubatanidzwa nehurumende kweinvoisi dzedhijitari kunoshanda muSaudi Arabia chete. Mune dzimwe nyika dzese kunowanikwa kana kwakumbirwa. Tafura iri pasi inoratidza, panyika imwe neimwe, mari yemunyika imomo, chiyero chinowanzoshandiswa chemutero wekutengesa kana VAT, uye kana kubatanidzwa nehurumende kweinvoisi dzedhijitari kuchishanda kana kuchiwanikwa kana kwakumbirwa.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Tinotsigira kubatanidzwa kweChikamu Chechipiri nepuratifomu yeFatoora yeZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Mari nechiyero chemutero zvinoiswa nekambani imwe neimwe pamarongero ayo. Ziyero zviri patafura iyi inhungamiro yakajairika uye zvinogona kuchinja; bvunza chipangamazano wako wemutero nezvemitemo yazvino. Mutsetse (—) unoreva kuti hapana chiyero chinowanzoshandiswa chakanyorwa panyika iyoyo.
strings.tierB.about.title: Nezve FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales inogadzira software ye-cloud yemakambani anogovera ane vatengesi vanoshanyira vatengi. Yakavambwa muna 2026 muRiyadh, kuSaudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (zita muchiArabic: فيلد سيلز) ipuratifomu ye-cloud yemakambani anogovera nekutengesa zvakawanda ane vatengesi vanoshanyira vatengi. Kambani yakavambwa muna 2026 uye ine muzinda wayo muRiyadh, kuSaudi Arabia. Inoshandira makambani munyika dzese, uye mari nechiyero chemutero chenyika imwe neimwe zvinoiswa pamarongero ekambani pachayo. Vatengi vedu makambani anotengesa nekuendesa zvinhu kuburikidza nevatengesi vari munzira: vagoveri, vatengesi vezvakawanda nevagadziri vane mavheni avo ekutengesera.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Tinovaka sisitimu imwe chete yakabatana yebasa rese remunzira: invoisi dzinodhindwa nefoni yemutengesi, risiti nemabharanzi evatengi, sitoko yevheni yakachengetwa nemutengesi, nzira nekushanya nenzvimbo nemifananidzo, uye dashboard yewebhu yemamaneja. App yemutengesi inoshanda paAndroid neiPhone uye inoramba ichishanda pasina indaneti, yobva yatumira magwaro netiweki yadzoka. Makambani anogona kubatanidza FieldSales nesisitimu yawo ye-accounting kana ERP kuburikidza neAPI, kuitira kuti data yemunzira isanyorwa kaviri.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Tinotsanangura chigadzirwa sezvachiri. Tinotsigira kubatanidzwa kweChikamu Chechipiri nepuratifomu yeFatoora yeZATCA. Kubatanidzwa nemasisitimu ehurumende mune dzimwe nyika kunowanikwa kana kwakumbirwa. App inowanikwa mumitauro iyi: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; haiwanikwe muchiShona. Kuti utaure nesu, kumbira kotesheni, bhuka musangano kana kuti titumire meseji paWhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Taura neFieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Taura nechikwata cheFieldSales: kumbira kotesheni, bhuka musangano kana kuti taura nesu paWhatsApp nezve software yekutengesa nevheni.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tiudze matengesero anoita vatengesi vako nhasi uye zvaunoda kuchinja. Kumbira kotesheni, bhuka musangano kana kuti titumire meseji paWhatsApp, uye nhengo yechikwata chedu ichakupindura. Makambani atove kushandisa FieldSales anogona kushandisa nzira idzi kuti awane rubatsiro. Zvinobatsira kutaura nyika yako, huwandu hwevatengesi uye kana vachitengesa vari mumavheni, vachitora maodha kana zvese zviri zviviri.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Bhuka musangano wepaindaneti nechikwata chedu. Tichakuratidza zuva remutengesi muapp nedashboard yamaneja, tichishandisa mienzaniso iri pedyo nezvigadzirwa zvako nenzira dzako, uye tichapindura mibvunzo yako nezvekugadzirisa.
